title: Vaulted Corridor
summary: A narrow, sloping corridor ascends through a reinforced concrete vault, its walls lined with flickering emergency lights and a single open maintenance hatch.
arrival_narration: You step through the checkpoint’s northern gate into a steep, dimly lit corridor. The air smells of ozone and rust. A single emergency light hums overhead, casting jagged shadows. To your left, a **maintenance hatch** is propped open, revealing a ladder descending into darkness. A **wall-mounted keypad** glows faintly beside it, its screen blank. A **metal cabinet** stands half-open, its contents obscured by a tattered inspection placard pinned to its door.

spatial_anomalies: keypad emits faint static when approached
